_instructions: Copy to ignored out/package-spec.json in a CLEAN committed project; paths resolve from the spec directory (adjust paths accordingly). Pins are lowercase SHA256 of exact bytes. file resolves relative to producer manifest; record is JSON pointer to its existing bytes/sha256 object.

runtime_source pins the complete launcher source-manifest.json {revision,files:{path:{bytes,sha256,...}}}. Build revision may precede release source_commit for docs-only changes; every packaged runtime source and closed membership must still match committed release source. Root manifest provenance and runtime descriptors are checked against that snapshot.

NVMe producer inputs.roots_manifest must equal runtime manifest byte/hash pin; partition_payloads root-a/root-b must match runtime files root-A.ext4/root-B.ext4. Optional root-update[-a/-b] producer must be that runtime manifest itself.

Run --plan --candidate to obtain each expected_dependency_fingerprint, then create pinned gate receipt JSON: {gate,status:PASS,scope,dependency_fingerprint,observations:[{id,kind,path,sha256}]}. Raw observation paths resolve relative to the receipt. Scope strings and required kinds are fixed in configs/beta-release.json. SPI gate counts >=3 unique cold plus >=3 unique warm observations, including retained applicable records.

REUSED requires applicability:{assessed_by,basis,dependency_fingerprint} matching the planned relevant inputs. SPI totals bind SPI firmware, NVMe boot_files and hardware_compatibility, not whole root/NVMe bytes. Include >=3 cold and >=3 warm applicable observations plus a manual-profile observation carrying runtime_fingerprint equal to the plan. Retained observations may be referenced in newly scoped applicability receipts; never invent physical observations.

Candidate packaging tolerates BLOCKED/MISSING physical/software gates and always stays candidate. Normal packaging requires every gate PASS/REUSED. No new soak or upstream KVM/QEMU qualification is required.

Every asset distribution assessment binds sha256; source_distribution binds source_commit. Public packaging requires personalized=false, private_identity=false, redistribution=granted, assessed_by/basis and a pinned grant:{path,sha256} for each assessment. These are operator assertions, not legal clearance or secret scanning. Current personalized recovery and unresolved vendor firmware remain private.

Assets are copied and checked once without decompressing/rebuilding. --plan checks producer pins and sizes but does not hash large asset content. Output must be a new directory whose parent exists. No device writes or upload occurs.

Public distribution additionally needs metadata_distribution for all pinned runtime/producer/evidence/source/grant metadata: same assessment schema with sha256 bound to metadata_content_fingerprint from a private --plan. Include its grant pin before planning to bind that grant too. Source assessment covers committed source archive, operator guides and notices; no private identity may be asserted absent without review. Pinned input paths map to content-addressed receipt paths in release-manifest.json.

Manual lifecycle receipt kinds: boot,cpu,disk,http,shutdown,checkpoint,restart,persistence; manual_lifecycle_context binds the actual guest fixture and storage plan. Recovery kinds: recovery,host-rollback,guest-backup,guest-restore. Software fingerprints bind code/tests/policies/runtime, excluding documentation and .codex prose.

operator/docs includes committed references to preserve guide links; full committed source remains in source/. Physical evidence is asserted by the operator and is not independently tested by packaging.
